## Expected and actual behavior

Affected UNI issue/module and specification/ADR requirement:

## Reproduction

1. Use synthetic data and state the environment/runtime versions.
2. Give the smallest reproducible steps and actual result.

## Sanitized evidence

Provide nonprivate logs/screenshots, exact command results and local versus remote CI status. Do not include .env values, tokens, owner contact/proof, private coordinates or real identity documents. A public issue is not a confidential evidence channel; urgent privacy/security exposure needs restricted human escalation without publishing the affected data.

## Scope and verification

Affected paths, regression test, expected fix and known limitations:

All Git actions remain human-only. Fix branches integrate into dev by git merge --ff-only; PR optional, no merge commits, main stable releases only.
